title: Start where it starts
summary: The kit's D2 statement close: “Start where / every engagement starts.” with the audit in one line, the red ask and the quiet door, then the onward question to the field notes and the Lab at its true status.
story: The page has shown the person, the rules and the week; every one of those starts with the audit (rule 01: diagnosis before prescription), so the close says so in the page's second and last two-voice line and asks for it. Readers not ready to buy get two ways on: how Kelwin thinks (field notes) and what it is building (the Lab, in development).
